description: French nouns a learner meets without an article: the months («en janvier»; «le 8 janvier» only with a date) and the days of the week («dimanche» is Sunday; «le dimanche» means on Sundays). Their card shows the bare word: the server sends them no gender, which is what a client draws le / la from. Curated by hand (#1083). Read by app/services/lexicon_grammar.py.
